notes.title: January Update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Added grass to the map  
- Added swimming  
- Fixed a bug with double constructions  
- Added landmines

notes.title: Happy new year update!
notes.notes:
Change Log

- Fixed a bug with sleep state.  
- Added quick item transfer.  
- Fixed a bug where the mouse would move outside the game window.  
- Fixed a visual bug with inventory slots.  
- Replaced right mouse button for item dragging with the left mouse button.  
- Fixed scope sensitivity functionality.  
- Added bleeding mechanics.  
- Added a health bar for the environment.  
- Added item name tooltips in the inventory.  
- Fixed a bug with duplicate structures.
- Added XMAS Event

notes.title: Update December 11, 2024
notes.notes:
Update Changelog
- Fixed minor issues with sleeping bag replication.  
- Resolved fuel replication issues in buggies.  
- Fixed construction upgrade replication display.  
- Fixed exploit allowing damage through walls.  
- Resolved issue preventing tent boxes from opening.  
- Removed the junkyard from the map.  
- Steam nicknames are now used in-game.  
- Fixed missing vehicle sound bug.  
- Fixed construction sound issues.  
- Fixed player inventory saving issues.  
- Added support for Russian language.
